design.spatial_metrics: zero-output sidechain after HRTF/headphone correction; diagnostics only
design.localization_error: cue-consistency proxy, not human localization ground truth
design.reflection_character: bounded 3-tap early-reflection playback cue; not physical room reflectivity
design.cpu_scheduler: navigator.hardwareConcurrency capacity hint only; browser owns JIT/audio thread/core scheduling
design.av_sync: optional positive audio delay 0-150 ms; useful only when audio leads video
design.multitab: tabId-keyed independent capture ON/OFF; concurrent sources share the global DSP bus
design.per_tab_settings: not implemented in v2.8; settings are global/shared

jiro_final_audit.note: deterministic design audit; browser endurance/listening remain empirical
